milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight chooses to rescue Zote from the Vengefly King's mandibles in Greenpath; if not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, Zote dies there.

milestones.name: Zote appears in Dirtmouth
milestones.note: After being saved in Greenpath, Zote travels to Dirtmouth and speaks arrogantly to the Knight.

milestones.name: Zote encountered in City of Tears corridor
milestones.note: Zote is found in a corridor leading back to the storerooms of the City of Tears; he has forgotten the Knight and reintroduces himself.

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Zote is found stuck in spider webs in Deepnest; Knight can save or leave him without fatal consequence.

milestones.name: Zote boss fight at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: If saved both times, Zote is captured and becomes the final boss of the first Colosseum trial. Deals no damage; beating him grants the Rivalry achievement.

milestones.name: Neglect achievement
milestones.note: Granted by hitting Zote's shell in Greenpath after he dies (not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw).

milestones.name: Rivalry achievement
milestones.note: Granted by defeating Zote at the Colosseum of Fools.

milestones.name: Love Key obtained
milestones.note: Found in Queen's Gardens; unlocks the door inside the Tower of Love where the Collector can be fought.

milestones.name: Collector boss accessible
milestones.note: Using the Love Key opens the door inside the Tower of Love to fight the Collector.

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Hub town; Zote arrives here after being saved in Greenpath and speaks arrogantly to the Knight.

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Path where Zote is found held in the mandibles of a Vengefly King; Knight can save or abandon him.

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found in a corridor leading back to the storerooms; he has forgotten the Knight.

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found stuck in spider webs, presumably captured by the beasts of Deepnest.

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote is in the resting area and becomes the final boss of the first trial here.

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where the Love Key is found.

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.fingerprintHint: Door unlocked by the Love Key; the Collector can be fought inside.

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Used as a progression gating marker — if Zote is not saved before this is acquired, he dies in Greenpath.

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks the door inside the Tower of Love where the Collector can be fought.
abilities.note: Covered in padding and bears a symbol of love. Type: Key.

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight must defeat it to rescue Zote.

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first Colosseum trial. Deals no damage due to shellwood nail. Must simply be attacked until the fight ends. Beating him grants the Rivalry achievement.

bosses.name: Collector
bosses.note: Fought inside the Tower of Love after opening the door with the Love Key.
